questions.prompt: 다음 중 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르세요.
body: • A woman ____(A)____ by the police for stealing a bag.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 (A)~(E)에 들어갈 말로 알맞지 않은 것을 고르세요.
body: • Paper is mainly made ____(A)____ wood.
• A cake was made ____(B)____ me by Dad.
• The parcel was sent ____(C)____ me by Mina.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 (A)~(E)에 들어갈 말로 알맞지 않은 것을 고르세요.
body: • Many kinds of plants are ____(A)____ in this greenhouse.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장을 수동태 문장으로 바꿔 쓰세요.
body: Mina sent me some beautiful postcards.
→ Some beautiful postcards ________________.
questions.answer: were sent to me by Mina

questions.prompt: 다음 문장을 수동태 문장으로 바꿔 쓰세요.
body: This notice tells us not to touch the paintings.
questions.answer: are told not to touch the paintings by the notice

questions.prompt: 다음 중 우리말을 바르게 영작한 두 개를 고르세요.

choices.text: 그 지붕은 우박에 맞았다. → The roof was struck by hail.
나는 내일 시험이 걱정된다. → I’m worried with the test tomorrow.
결과는 아직 발표되지 않았다. → The result has not be announced yet.
나는 훌륭한 발표로 선생님께 칭찬을 받았다. → I was praised my teacher for my great presentation.

body: I invited to the wedding by Mina’s family.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞은 문장의 개수를 고르세요.
body: ⓐ Cheese is made from milk.
ⓑ The scarf was made of me by my aunt.
ⓒ The report is contained useful data.
ⓓ My dog was appeared from behind the door.
ⓔ The violin was being played in the next room.

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 올바르게 배열하세요.
body: 그 언덕은 눈으로 뒤덮여 있었다.
(was / the hill / with / snow / covered)
questions.answer: The hill was covered with snow

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 올바르게 배열하세요.
body: 나는 아빠께 캠핑 가는 것을 허락 받았다.
(by / camping / my dad / allowed / I / to go / was)
questions.answer: I was allowed to go camping by my dad

questions.prompt: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 것을 찾아 그 기호를 쓰고 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: When I ⓐ [[was arrived]] at the station to meet Sora, the platform ⓑ [[was filled]] with many travelers. I ⓒ [[was surprised]] by the crowd, and it was hard to spot her. But I ⓓ [[was pleased]] with seeing her after such a long time.
